site.source: Rating and match data come from the game's own servers and may lag by a few minutes.

home.title: Compete with players at your level
home.subtitle: Track your rating, join a league in your bracket and play tournaments with a real shot at the podium.

add.title: Add a player
add.hint: Paste a Steam profile link, a SteamID64, an AoE2 profile_id or the exact in-game nickname.
add.free: No account needed. Anyone can add anyone.

one.title: Add
one.text: Paste a Steam link or nickname. The portal starts tracking the rating on every ladder.

two.title: Join your bracket
two.text: Leagues have rating divisions, from Shield to Crown. If you're at 900, you compete with people at 900.

three.title: Compete
three.text: Tournaments per division. Results are confirmed from the game's match history, no screenshots.

search.title: Which one is you?
search.homonyms: We found {count} profiles with the nickname "{alias}". Pick the right one by flag, rating and last match.
search.none: No profile with the exact nickname "{alias}". The search is case-sensitive and needs the full in-game name.
search.noneSteam: That Steam account has no AoE2 DE profile, or has never played online.
search.invalid: Couldn't parse that. Paste a Steam link, a numeric id or a nickname.
search.vanityFail: Couldn't resolve that Steam link. Try the /profiles/ link or the SteamID64.
search.rateLimited: Too many additions from your network in the last hour. Try again later.
search.apiDown: The game server didn't respond. Try again in a few minutes.

player.noRatings: No ranked games on any ladder.
player.noMatches: No matches recorded yet. History arrives on the first full sync.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.steamOnly: Sign-in is Steam only. We store no password or e-mail.
auth.why: Signed in, you can claim your profile, join leagues and create your own.
auth.claimDone: Profile claimed. It now shows as yours.
auth.claimNoProfile: Your Steam account has no AoE2 DE profile. Play an online game and try again.
auth.failed: Steam sign-in failed. Please try again.

me.title: My profile
me.notLogged: Sign in with Steam to see your profile.
me.noPlayer: No AoE2 profile linked to this Steam account.

leagues.title: Leagues
leagues.intro: A league groups players into divisions by rating band. Your band is set by your peak RM 1v1 rating and stays frozen until the season ends. Within a division, a win is worth 3 points and a loss 1.
leagues.globalHint: Open to everyone. Join and show up in your band's table.
leagues.createHint: Your crew, your Discord, your city. You set the bands.
leagues.loginToCreate: Sign in with Steam to create a league.
leagues.empty: No leagues besides the global one yet.
leagues.noMatches: No matches between members yet. Play a 1v1 and it shows up here on the next sync.

join.preview: You'll enter the {division} division with rating {rating}.
join.login: Sign in with Steam to join.
join.no_rating: You don't have an RM 1v1 rating yet. Play ranked 1v1 games and come back.
join.few_games: Not enough ranked 1v1 games: you have {games} and the league requires {min}. This keeps new accounts out of the wrong band.
join.no_division: No division covers rating {rating} in this league.
join.no_season: This league has no open season.

rules.title: How it works
rules.placement: Your division is set by your all-time peak RM 1v1 rating, not your current one. If you've been high, you can't enter a low band.
rules.detect: Any 1v1 between two members of the same division counts automatically: ranked or lobby, no reporting.
rules.detectLobby: Only lobby games between two members of the same division count. Ranked games are excluded.
rules.points: Win 3 points, loss 1. Ties broken by wins, then rating.
rules.season: Your division stays frozen until the season ends. Then everyone is re-placed by their current rating.

new.title: New league
new.name: Name
new.descriptionPlaceholder: Who can join, extra rules, Discord link…
new.countRankedHint: Uncheck to count only arranged (lobby) games.
new.divisionsHint: Edit name and band. Leave the name blank to drop the row. Empty cap = no limit.

errors.name: Give it a name between 3 and 60 characters.
errors.divisions: You need at least one division with a valid band.
errors.overlap: Bands can't overlap, and the minimum can't exceed the cap.
errors.slug: A league with that name already exists. Pick another.
